name: xyo-skills
description: XYO and XL1 agent skills for building dApps on the XL1 blockchain: a planning wizard, project scaffolding (React + indexer service, or the dapp-kit headless runtime), prescriptive design patterns, XL1 chain and gateway knowledge, XYO primitives, and testing with a dApp Definition of Done. Requires companion ariestools-skills for xy-development and xy-toolchain.

interface.longDescription: A layered skill stack for XL1 dApps and XYO protocol integrations. xl1-build turns a vague request into a spec and xl1-scaffold bootstraps it; xl1-patterns covers commit-reveal, indexing, inscriptions, tokens, Statement Graph and Event Kit wakes plus multi-party architecture principles; xl1-dapp-kit covers @xyo-network/dapp-kit headless runtimes; xl1-testing covers local chains, Sequence verification and the dApp Definition of Done; xl1-knowledge and xyo-knowledge cover the chain, gateway, datalakes and protocol primitives. Install ariestools-skills alongside for TypeScript toolchain and development workflow standards.
defaultPrompt: Plan an XL1 dApp with me
